commentary: The benchmark surge on November 5, 2026, driven by collapsing crude and aggressive FII inflows, signals an O'Neil follow-through attempt. However, with market breadth at an uncommitted 50 and our deterministic macro gate locked on Caution, Stan Weinstein's stage discipline commands strict selectivity. Benchmark thrusts lack durability when participation remains clustered in select blue chips and defense. Under Minervini's SEPA framework, progressive exposure is mandatory: we neither anticipate breakouts nor chase extended pivots. Focus strictly on Stage 2 candidates displaying genuine CANSLIM earnings acceleration and Volatility Contraction Patterns (VCP). Until breadth broadens and follow-through days demonstrate sustained institutional sponsorship, prioritize aggressive risk containment and enforce rigid stop losses.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA / O'Neil CANSLIM / Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Forming a 23.3% deep cup with a constructive 6.8% handle in the upper half of its base. Price holds above the rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 53 confirming non-extended upside momentum.
63MOONS.fundamental: Brokerage technology provider saw Q1 FY27 sales jump 349.5% YoY, but swung to a net loss of ₹39.7 crore. Low ROE of 1.5% and erratic bottom-line performance fail O'Neil CANSLIM quality filters despite a virtually debt-free balance sheet.
63MOONS.risk: A breakdown below the handle pivot low at 880.20 invalidates the structure; cut losses immediately to protect capital.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Constructing a double bottom base testing neckline resistance at 114.91. Price trades above key rising moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) with RSI at 54, but relative strength lags top-quartile market leaders.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: API and chemical manufacturer suffers from severe fundamental deceleration, with revenue down 56.3% and profit contracting 25.6% YoY. Operating margin remains razor-thin at 1.5% alongside a depressed ROCE of 5.6%, missing all CANSLIM criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Failure to hold the double bottom swing-low floor at 103.61 breaches support; exit swiftly per strict risk rules.

ACUTAAS.technical: Pristine Stage 2 breakout from a double bottom consolidation, pressing past 4049.35 on expanding relative strength. RSI at 68 and bullish MACD alignment indicate strong institutional demand above upward-sloping moving averages.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: High-conviction CANSLIM profile. Advanced pharma intermediate and CDMO leader generated 42.7% sales growth, 86.2% PAT growth, and 40.3% EBITDA margin in Q2 FY27. Bolstered by zero net debt, 31.6% ROCE, and upward-revised forward guidance.
ACUTAAS.risk: Close below the swing pivot low at 3637.50 invalidates base integrity; execute an immediate SEPA protective stop.

ADANIGREEN.technical: Executing a 20-day high breakout above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 59 reflects steady accumulation without technical extension, accompanied by positive MACD crossover confirming short-term momentum.
ADANIGREEN.fundamental: Rapid capacity expansion drove a 41.5% jump in revenue and 16% rise in net profit to ₹747 crore for Q2 FY27. However, capital intensity, high leverage, and a modest ROCE of 7.4% trail CANSLIM tier-one standards.
ADANIGREEN.risk: A violation of the 20-day consolidation platform stop at 1329.50 voids the setup; cut the position decisively.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Textbook Stage 2 continuation breakout to fresh 52-week highs on 1.29x average volume. The stock adheres strictly to Minervini's 8-point Trend Template, comfortably riding its rising 21-EMA, 50-DMA, and 200-DMA.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Dominant logistics gateway delivers solid operational leverage with Q2 FY27 revenue up 24% to ₹11,340 crore and PAT up 18% to ₹3,682 crore. Supported by stellar 60% EBITDA margins, 14.1% ROCE, and raised management guidance.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Any retest failing below the breakout pivot stop at 1776.35 mandates immediate exit to limit drawdown.

AEROFLEX.technical: Bullish double bottom base characterized by a 3-up accumulation sequence off the rising EMA21 and SMA50. MACD resides above signal and zero lines, confirming dominant trend-following sponsorship into pivot breakout.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Exceptional CANSLIM credentials propelled by data center liquid cooling infrastructure demand. Q2 FY27 revenue soared 87% YoY while net profit jumped 157%. Backed by 24.3% EBITDA margin, 18.9% ROCE, minimal leverage, and ₹202 crore growth capex.
AEROFLEX.risk: A breach of the double bottom support level at 529.97 aborts the structural pattern; exit strictly per rule discipline.
